what: A giant word filling the screen width: when it enters the section, each letter flies in from off the right edge of the screen (100vw) in .1s sequence at 1.7s power2.inOut and stands in place — the first letter settles first and the last slides in last, so the word spacing spreads wide and then gathers

options.from: right (default) | left — side it flies in from
options.trigger: Reference ancestor selector (starts when that section enters), default itself

note: Uses SplitText if available, otherwise splits letters manually. Set the section to overflow: clip so there is no horizontal overflow while they fly in

from.where: index.html roots section .ba-roots__huge — original SplitText chars from x 100vw stagger .1 1.7s power2.inOut, trigger #Roots .trigger (start default top bottom)
